seoTitle: XSD Validator: Check XML Against a Schema | Free
metaDescription: Validate XML against an XSD 1.0 schema in your browser: order, occurrences, attributes, types, enumerations and patterns, with paths.
intro: Checks an XML document against an XML Schema and lists each problem with its path.
why:
A schema error found late costs time. This page checks the common parts of XSD 1.0: sequence, choice and all content, minOccurs and maxOccurs, attributes, built-in types, restrictions, lists, unions and type extension.

It is a hand-written subset, not a full validator. Namespaces are ignored, identity constraints and other files (import, include) are not followed, and the page lists what it skipped. Verdicts matched lxml on 20 test documents; for final sign-off use your normal toolchain.
howTo: Paste the XML in the first box.
Paste the XSD in the second box.
Read the list of problems with their paths.

faq.a: No. It is a good sign for common schemas. Confirm with xmllint or your build tool.
